Calls out institutional waste, golden parachutes, and media spin in favor of real-world results.
Champions national sovereignty, fiscal discipline, and common-sense accountability for Spokane County.
talking_points: The MAGA and conservative reaction to Spokane County is unmistakable: back our police and armed law-abiding citizens who stop threats, ditch soft-on-crime D.A. policies, and lock up criminals.
Every American family deserves safe schools and streets—incidents like Spokane County prove why firm law enforcement and constitutional self-defense rights are non-negotiable.

controversial_take.statement: Would you like more follow-up reporting on this story?

instant_answer: A Spokane County sheriff's deputy died and another is on life support after a SWAT team was ambushed responding to a domestic violence call.
